Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse NpcVisibility

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcVisibility
public final class NpcVisibility extends Object
The built-in rules deciding which players an NPC is shown to.

Only the two checks that every server needs live here — distance and a permission node — and both are deliberately cheap, because the tracker evaluates them for every player and every nearby NPC many times a second. Anything richer (a region, a party, a quest state) belongs in a NpcVisibilityRule registered by an extension, which the tracker consults only after these have passed.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • visibleByDefault

      public boolean visibleByDefault()
      Returns whether the NPC is shown to players that were not explicitly told about it.

      Setting this to false turns the NPC into an opt-in one: it is only rendered for players passed to Npc.show(org.bukkit.entity.Player). That is how a per-player NPC — a quest giver only the questing player can see — is built.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if visible to everyone by default
